patterns.name: CallInEditor on UEditorUtilityObject descendant
patterns.description: CallInEditor buttons don't appear in Details panel for UEditorUtilityObject-based classes. UEditorUtilityObject is designed for Blutility scripts that run via Asset Actions, not Details panel buttons.

fix_suggestion.primary: Use UActorActionUtility with SupportedClasses meta specifier instead
